results.name: Proposition 2.1
results.presentation: Two linear reductions between subsumption and incoherence; semantic equivalences displayed.

results.name: Proposition 2.2
results.presentation: Linear-time simplification to simple descriptions; source does not print induction or size calculation.

results.name: Proposition 2.3
results.presentation: CNF/one-element-model reduction proving ALU-coherence NP-hard and subsumption coNP-hard.

results.name: Proposition 3.1
results.presentation: Coherence is satisfiability of the root constraint pair; explicitly stated without source proof.

results.name: Propositions 3.2 and 3.3
results.presentation: Five deterministic unfolding rewrites; source satisfiability equivalence and linear-time claims stated without proofs.

results.name: Theorem 3.4
results.presentation: Linear-time fresh constraint-tree translation by composing the preceding steps.

results.name: Proposition 4.1
results.presentation: Exact clash forms and linear detection; source states unsatisfiability without proof.

results.name: Proposition 4.2
results.presentation: Complete-system satisfiability iff clash-free; full local canonical-model argument covers every constraint, total assignment and the empty-occurring-individual case.

results.name: Proposition 4.3
results.presentation: Three completion-step equivalences. Source omits proofs; handbook supplies witness/union/removal arguments with existential branch choice, not arbitrary-branch preservation.

results.name: Proposition 4.4
results.presentation: Controlled rules and source termination/normal-form/tree invariants; article gives no proof.

results.name: Theorem 4.5
results.presentation: Clash-free completion criterion and existence; handbook expands the source's one-sentence dependency proof, relying on preceding source propositions.

results.name: Proposition 5.1
results.presentation: Unique individual root and unique predecessor for every other individual in partial completions.

results.name: Proposition 5.2
results.presentation: Four trace facts, explicitly without source proofs: unique individual per concept variable, linear derivation length, trace-to-completion containment and finite trace union.

results.name: Figure 3 eval specification
results.presentation: Recursive disjunction for unions and conjunction over existential edges; successor call retains membership data without adding the role edge. Correctness/linear-space analysis is source-bounded.

results.name: Theorem 5.3
results.presentation: Linear-space coherence/subsumption; source supplies no machine encoding, bit-level stack analysis, explicit constant or separate correctness induction.

results.name: Propositions 5.4, 5.6, 5.7, 5.8
results.presentation: Restricted-language completion/trace criteria; renaming uniqueness, linear top-completion bound and missing-target ALU leaf argument.

results.name: Theorems 5.5, 5.9, 5.10
results.presentation: ALE incoherence nondeterministic linear-time/coherence coNP membership; ALU coherence NP-complete; AL coherence linear-time.

results.name: Theorem 6.1
results.presentation: Source QBF-validity problem is PSPACE-complete; cited, not proved in the article.

results.name: Lemma 6.2
results.presentation: Quadratic one-role/one-concept QBF reduction with prefix/clause trees, canonical assignments and two directions; source correspondence/literal inductions are abbreviated and the handbook identifies its reconstructions.

results.name: Theorem 6.3
results.presentation: Standalone ALC coherence and subsumption PSPACE-complete; local complement-reduction step is explicitly added.

results.name: Theorem 4.6
results.presentation: Quoted source FL coherence statement; FL is not introduced as a usable local language, because its full grammar belongs to prior authorities.

NNF induction and size calculation omitted by source.

Source constraint systems are finite nonempty sets; normalization results are reported as source statements without their omitted proofs.
Extraction is locally made valid for empty occurring-individual set using a fresh singleton domain and total assignment; fresh input trees have an individual root.
Completion-step proof elaborations are local additions; nondeterministic union only preserves existence of a satisfiable branch.
Termination is a source statement; local Theorem 4.5 reconstruction does not silently supply its omitted proof.
Two local examples are distinct from source Figure 2's unindexed exponential family with ellipsis.
Trace invariants and bounds are source statements with no printed proof.
Source eval is not literally a basic edge-adding completion rule, and its encoded stack analysis/correctness induction are not printed.
Trace no-successor test is across all roles; top-completion no-successor test is role-specific.
The historical termination/space argument uses finite constraint trees and discarded traces, not ancestor blocking, caching, or cyclic-TBox reasoning.
Detailed source proof-granularity census distinguishes full model verification, source statements without proofs, short arguments and local reconstructions.
Features are a brief source comparison; no general TBox/ABox, role hierarchy, number restrictions or blocking imported from the 1991 article.
Local blocking proof at annex:p9.alc.1; general-TBox body/types and annex:p9.alc.3 lower bound/finite-KB reductions are separate dependencies to inspect.

concrete_remaining.item: Exact 2003 first-edition and 2017 textbook bodies and their own rules, blocking, examples and proof organization remain required.
A usable FL language would require the prior authorities' grammar; it is currently retained only as a source theorem identifier.
